items.title: Tim Kelly Interview, 1979-03-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...you hear Weedhoff and Jimmy Dorsey... [INTERVIEWEE] Most certainly. He played all of those things.

ctx.x: Yeah. There were a lot of them. Well, of course, you hear Weedhoff and Jimmy Dorsey, even. I mean, that kind of fingering. And Al Galladero, it tripped his hat to Weedhoff.
Most certainly. He played all of those things. In fact, Galladero was really a great saxophonist and playing there's no question about it. And bassoon player. I didn't know he played bassoon.
